content.text: In Kenya, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/why-selling-design-assets-crypto-payments-only-real|Why Selling]] digital products like [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-sell-ebooks-kenya-step-step-deployment-guide-5|COREMERCH guide to ebooks]] globally is a non-starter with Stripe or PayPal. Both platforms block accounts in restricted regions, leaving creators stranded without payment options. [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/bitcoin-payments-digital-downloads-what-actually-how-works-4|bitcoin]] offers a solution, but integrating it requires infrastructure that won’t fail under pressure. This analysis compares your real options for accepting Bitcoin without relying on third-party platforms. We’ll evaluate each solution’s architecture, costs, and ownership model to determine which one delivers sovereignty, not just a workaround. The goal is clear: build a commerce stack you own, where payment rejection is impossible by design.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Bitcoin ebook

Option 1: NOWPayments + GitHub Pages. NOWPayments handles Bitcoin payments with a 0.5% fee, no KYC, and automatic webhook integration. GitHub Pages hosts your storefront for free. This stack works but lacks automation for file delivery. Option 2: COREMERCH Edge Commerce Stack ($197). Combines Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments for automated delivery, order storage, and end-to-end testing. Option 3: Custom WordPress + BTCPay Server. Requires hosting, SSL, and manual setup. BTCPay is free but complex. Option 4: Gumroad + Bitcoin invoices. Gumroad is unavailable in Kenya, making this option irrelevant. The Edge Commerce Stack wins for its automated delivery and zero-dependency architecture.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

NOWPayments + GitHub Pages works in restricted regions but requires manual file delivery, defeating the purpose of automation. COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack is designed for regions like Kenya, with Cloudflare Workers handling delivery without relying on third-party platforms. Custom WordPress + BTCPay Server works but demands ongoing maintenance and hosting costs. Gumroad’s unavailability in Kenya disqualifies it. The Edge Commerce Stack is the only option built to operate in financial isolation, with no platform dependencies.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

NOWPayments confirms Bitcoin payments on-chain within minutes, charging 0.5%. GitHub Pages is free, but manual delivery adds labor costs. The Edge Commerce Stack costs $197 upfront but includes automated delivery, saving time and errors. Custom WordPress + BTCPay Server is free but requires hosting ($10–$50/month) and SSL ($10/year). Gumroad’s 10% fee is irrelevant since it’s unavailable. The Edge Commerce Stack’s one-time fee delivers lifetime ownership, making it the lowest long-term cost option.
Bitcoin payments confirm on-chain within minutes, with fees under 0.5%.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

NOWPayments + GitHub Pages gives you ownership of payments but not delivery. The Edge Commerce Stack hands you full ownership of the entire stack, from hosting to delivery, with no recurring fees. Custom WordPress + BTCPay Server offers ownership but ties you to hosting providers. Gumroad owns your data and payment flow. The Edge Commerce Stack is the only option where you own everything after deployment, with no platform dependencies.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you sell fewer than 5 products and can handle manual delivery, NOWPayments + GitHub Pages is functional but inefficient. If you need automated delivery, full ownership, and zero platform dependencies, the Edge Commerce Stack is the clear winner. Custom WordPress + BTCPay Server is overkill for most creators and adds unnecessary complexity. Gumroad is not an option in Kenya. Choose the Edge Commerce Stack if you want sovereign commerce infrastructure that works today and ten years from now.

It combines Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments for automated delivery, order storage, and end-to-end testing. You own the entire stack after deployment, with no platform dependencies or recurring fees. It’s built for regions facing financial isolation, ensuring your commerce infrastructure operates regardless of external restrictions.
The Edge Commerce Stack automates file delivery, eliminating manual errors.

If you’re ready to deploy sovereign commerce infrastructure, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is designed for creators in regions like Kenya. It includes automated delivery, order storage, and end-to-end testing, all deployed within 48 hours. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to learn more.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use the Edge Commerce Stack if I’m not technical?
Yes, the Edge Commerce Stack is deployed and configured for you. After delivery, it requires no technical maintenance. You own the stack but don’t need to manage infrastructure.
What happens if Bitcoin fees are too high?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. Use low-fee networks like BSC, Solana, or TRON for transactions under $0.10.
Do I need to pay recurring fees?
No. The Edge Commerce Stack is a one-time payment of $197. You own everything after deployment, with no subscriptions or hidden costs.
Can I add more products later?
Yes. The stack is designed to scale. Add products manually or extend the backend logic using Cloudflare Workers.
What if I need support after deployment?
The Edge Commerce Stack includes 30-day support. For ongoing assistance, purchase additional support hours or use the documentation provided.
